items.name: CLI-Anything
items.hook: Makes any software agent-native by auto-generating a production-grade CLI for it via a 7-phase pipeline: source analysis, command architecture, Click implementation, test planning, documentation, and package publishing. The generated CLIs output JSON, support REPL mode, and include undo/redo. Install the Claude Code plugin and run `/cli-anything ./gimp` to make GIMP fully controllable by Claude — same for Blender, LibreOffice, and 50+ other apps. 51.1k stars; trending September 28.

items.name: Claude Code v2.1.285
items.hook: September 29 release ships three developer-quality-of-life features: `claude --desktop` opens the Claude desktop app on the current directory from the terminal, `claude plugin configure <plugin>` shows and sets a plugin's options, and the new `allowedProviders` managed setting lets admins restrict which API provider (Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry, Mantle, etc.) a machine may use. Also adds `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH` to turn off the WebFetch tool at the environment level. 136 changes in this release.

items.name: Hindsight
items.hook: Agent memory that learns rather than simply recalling conversation history. Uses biomimetic data structures to organize memories as world facts, experiences, observations, and mental models — with four parallel retrieval strategies (semantic, keyword, graph-based, temporal) running at once. Leads the LongMemEval benchmark, performance independently verified by Virginia Tech and The Washington Post. 43.7k stars; trending on GitHub September 28.

items.name: jevgrep
items.hook: A CLI for coding agents that finds code by asking what it does rather than what it says — returns relevant files, reading leads, and verbatim source excerpts in response to plain English questions like 'where is JWT validation?' The installer auto-detects Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode and places itself accordingly. In a 10-task SWE-bench comparison, reached the same 8/10 pass rate as the baseline at lower cost. 1.8k stars; trending September 30.

items.name: onetake
items.hook: A Claude Agent Skill for product launch films and feature demos where every beat grows from the one before — no cut, one continuous take.
